correctness.rationale: PASS: The minimally abundant consecutive-prime block B crosses 2 by its last prime, and C=product(1-p^-2)=1+O(1/P), giving phi(A)/A=C/B=1/2+O(1/P) from below. The Zumkeller divisor partition implies sigma(z)>=2z and phi(z)sigma(z)/z^2<1, proving the per-seed strict bound. Prime Mertens gives Q asymptotic P^2; iterated disjoint blocks have sum 1/P_j finite and log z_j<=exp(D*2^j), producing K*2^-r failure product. Linnik primes in the appropriate reduced residue classes force representation outside size O(z_j^(2L)), and CRT contributes X*2^-r plus the essential O(Z_r) endpoint error. Choosing 2^r comparable to log log X makes Z_r and thresholds X^o(1); separate even-seed Linnik step bounds odd exceptional integers by a power saving. Independently checked four rational prime blocks and three full-period CRT families; finite checks do not prove the global asymptotic.
